meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: Claude 能操控浏览器执行打开网页、点击元素、填写表单等操作,代替你完成网页上的任务。
howto.when: 当任务涉及浏览网页、填表、截图等,或浏览器会有帮助时触发;即使没有明确要求也会使用。

say.text: 打开 example.com,把首页截图给我
say.note: Claude 会打开页面并保存截图。

say.text: 在搜索框输入“天气”,然后点击搜索按钮
say.note: Claude 会填表并点击按钮。

say.text: 把当前页面上所有商品标题和链接提取出来
say.note: Claude 会提取页面上的文本和链接地址。

howto.what_en: Claude can drive a browser to open pages, click elements, fill forms, etc., performing web tasks for you.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever a browser would be useful, such as researching, filling forms, or taking screenshots, even if not explicitly asked.

say_en.text: Open example.com and screenshot the homepage.
say_en.note: Claude opens the page and saves a screenshot.

say_en.text: Type 'weather' in the search box and click the search button.
say_en.note: Claude fills the input and clicks.

say_en.text: Extract all product titles and links on this page.
say_en.note: Claude gets text and href attributes.
